content.explanation: Brendan Eich created the first version of JavaScript in approximately ten days during 1995. Netscape needed a browser scripting language quickly. Marketing also wanted the language to resemble Java enough to benefit from Java's popularity. The result was JavaScript, a language that eventually became central to the modern web.
content.example: Many developers still incorrectly assume JavaScript and Java are the same language.
content.analogy: A startup prototype that unexpectedly becomes a global product.
content.keyTakeaway: JavaScript began as a fast solution but became essential.

mcqs.question: Why was JavaScript named that way?
A company needs a fast prototype. Which lesson applies?
mcqs.explanation: JavaScript started as a quick solution.
